# Docker study notes

Use this shared note to add examples, questions, and explanations alongside the curated [Docker fundamentals guide](/dashboard/devops/docker).

## Key ideas

- An image is a read-only template; a container is an instance of an image.
- Containers share the host kernel; they are not virtual machines.
- Use volumes for data that must outlive a container.
